title: Seed Slinger
theme: A small luminous seed drifts through a calm sky garden. The player aims and launches the seed toward a blooming flower target, using bounce crystals and wind zones to guide its path while collecting dewdrops.
mechanics: Pull back on the seed to set aim and launch power, then release to fire
Gravity pulls the seed downward in an arc
Bounce off crystal walls with damping
Wind zones gently push the seed sideways
Collect floating dewdrops for bonus points
Reach the flower to complete the level; missing lets you retry instantly

controls.action: Aim and set launch power by dragging on
